mechanics.claim: The active grants a spell shield that blocks the next hostile ability/effect for its duration.
Blocking a hostile effect doubles the bonus attack speed for a further duration, giving increased damage output.
mechanics.quote: Upon successfully blocking a hostile effect, ''Shroud of Darkness' ''{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} is doubled for 5 seconds.

mechanics.claim: The passive bonus attack speed is always active regardless of the shield being up.
If active when recasting Paranoia to dash, the shield's duration is refreshed periodically during the dash.
mechanics.quote: If ''Shroud of Darkness'' is active when '''Nocturne''' re-casts ''{{ai|Paranoia|Nocturne}}'' to dash to a target, its duration is refreshed every {{fd|0.25 seconds}} during the dash.
